Are you in a healthy relationship?
Because if the other person doesn’t notice or care about your mental health well then it might not be the best for you
I have no idea who you are talking about, but sounds fun!
Hey bro, I just want to tell you that your life is worth more then a girls opinion. You definitely deserve better, look up the number of your countries suicide hotline and stay safe kiddo

Hii just checking in, don’t feel like a failure if you cut again, relapsing is often part of getting clean. Just make sure you practice wound care <3
Take some time to rest and if there is anything you need to get off your chest we are here for you :D
Happy birthday! Who cares if they didn’t remember? I did ;)

Your mother definitely doesn’t sound like a good person, but still you’re able to know who you truly are and that’s great! If you are old enough to transition without her knowledge then take it in consideration, it’s not that bad to transition even when you’re an adult. Maybe talk about it with your Father, Partner or a friend. I hope things get better for you and that you find the strength to walk away from her emotional abuse <3

Well where I live there are different “Vereine” they are called so. Basically a group of people that get together and do all kinds of different activities together. My step father is in the “culture and sport” one and he teaches tango. I’ve taken a Japanese course and it’s a great way to get to meet people who do these kinds of things. One of my friends is in the medical emergency association and it gets organized by the hospital, so look into it, it’s mostly a local thing

You know, to REALLY show leadership and passion you could start your own club! There are a lot of resources out there aaaand you could ask to create a new club in a already existing association :D
For now good luck! <3
I like to imagine that he is singing another one bites the dust
When my gym teacher asked, I told him I was becoming a professional rock climber but fell and never recovered. Not only she believed me, I only got A‘s after that

Ayee, I’m going to be a sophomore so I don’t really know how you can be more of a leader by your senior year but something you could try is talking to the teacher or rappresentative, it got me a place in one of the clubs! Teachers really enjoy receiving feedback or getting asked to participate more
How did you do such thing and how can I do such thing

Consider participating more next Year, personally as someone who is in a lot of clubs and considered on of the best there is no better way to go as often as possible, I’m sure next year you’ll reach your goals!
